sources.notes: Official competitor KMZ '50RICv2.kmz' (linked on the participants page) has vector SS LineStrings for all 9 distinct stage roads + shakedown, and the organiser's per-stage My Maps (linked on zonas-de-publico) repeat the same lines with explicit 'Start' and 'Flying Finish' placemarks; start/finish taken from those (within 4 m of the KMZ line ends, except SSS1/8 whose loop line has no distinct ends: markers 57-91 m from the loop's first vertex). kind set to 'points' only because the site legal notice requires prior written authorisation for any reproduction; vector data exists (routeRef kept). Placemark naming quirks (geometry confirmed by position/length): KMZ line for SS3/6 is named 'SS 4/7 Tejeda - San Mateo' inside folder 'SS 3/6 Tejeda San Mateo'; SS4/7 line is named 'La Aldea - Mogán' but runs Mogán->La Aldea (finish placemark at La Aldea end), consistent with itinerary 'Mogán - La Aldea'; My Maps start/finish labels carry stale numbers ('Start SS15-18' on Maspalomas, 'Finish SS8-11' on Arucas, 'Start SS7-10' on Moya). SSS1/8 is a closed loop drawn once (0.63 km) vs 1.89 km official (presumably ~3 laps; not stated); My Map has two Start and two Finish markers (parallel lanes) - first of each used. Lengths: SSS1/8 BP Ultimate - Las Palmas de Gran Canaria: KMZ line 0.63 km vs official 1.89; SS2/5 Valleseco - Artenara: KMZ line 13.12 km vs official 13.13; SS3/6 Tejeda - San Mateo: KMZ line 18.60 km vs official 18.62; SS4/7 Mogán - La Aldea: KMZ line 21.67 km vs official 21.70; SS9/12 Maspalomas: KMZ line 13.45 km vs official 13.47; SS10/13 Arucas - Firgas - Teror: KMZ line 13.73 km vs official 13.74; SS11/14 Moya - Gáldar: KMZ line 28.87 km vs official 28.90; SS15/17 Ingenio - Telde - Valsequillo: KMZ line 25.55 km vs official 25.93; SS16/18 Santa Lucía - Agüimes: KMZ line 13.25 km vs official 13.27. Shakedown Santa Brígida KMZ line 6.25 km vs 6.26.
